title: Local Speech Transcription
subtitle: .NET Speech-to-Text Prototype
summary: A local speech-to-text prototype built for integrating Chinese audio transcription into an internal .NET system.

overview.title: Overview
paragraphs: This project was developed as a proof of concept for adding Chinese speech transcription to an existing internal .NET system.
Because the system could not use external transcription APIs, the solution was designed to process audio locally using FFmpeg and Whisper.net.

responsibilities.title: Responsibilities
items: Survey available approaches for local speech transcription.
Select and integrate FFmpeg and Whisper.net with .NET 8.
Build and test a working Chinese speech-to-text prototype.
Demonstrate the solution and deliver the source code for further integration.

technical_highlights.title: Technical Highlights
paragraphs: The prototype keeps transcription local by converting source audio into a Whisper-compatible format with FFmpeg and processing it directly through Whisper.net.

items.title: Offline transcription requirement
items.description: The internal system could not rely on external transcription APIs, requiring a solution that could perform speech recognition locally.

items.title: Integrating speech recognition with .NET
items.description: The prototype needed to connect media preprocessing and Whisper inference into a simple workflow suitable for later integration with an existing .NET system.

outcome.title: Outcome
paragraphs: The completed prototype successfully demonstrated local Chinese speech transcription without relying on an external transcription API.

lessons_learned.title: Lessons Learned
items: Technical constraints can significantly influence architecture and technology selection.
A focused proof of concept can validate an integration approach before committing to full system development.
